We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the compound at hand, which we can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could also be that the system expects us to use carbon NMR to count methyl signals (CH3). Use carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count signals around ~10-30 ppm typical for methyl. Or use proton NMR to count methyl peaks (singlet, doublet, etc). Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count methyl signals (3H integration). But we don't have integration data. The tool returns spectra as string maybe with peaks.

We need to decide which tool to call. Use carbon_nmr_spectra first.
